A '''Jedi''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="JH" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="Note">The [[Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|''Champions of the Force'']] expansion set is set during the timeframe of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]].</ref> they lived as a hermit in a snowy environment. The Jedi was dark-skinned with [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and a beard, and wore brown [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]]. They also owned a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="JH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi was depicted on the "Jedi Hermit" card for the [[Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|''Champions of the Force'']] card set, which was the base set of cards for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]''.<ref name="JH" /> They were illustrated by artist [[Mark Poole]].<ref name="Game Interface">[[Sony]] Online Entertainment interface for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]''</ref>
